MyAcct - Peak Perks - Welcome to Peak Perks.

body: We miss you, {{first_name}}. Come back for a special rate.

name: Renewal Offer
subject: Time to renew
body: Hi {{first_name}}, your {{plan}} contract ends soon. Renew in My Account to lock in a rate.

name: Survey - 90 Day Check-In
subject: You've been with us 90 days. How's it going?
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

You've had your electricity with us for about 90 days now on {{plan}}. We'd love to hear how it's going: it takes two minutes.

{{survey:90-day-check-in}}

Thanks for being a customer.

name: Survey - Farewell
subject: Sorry to see you go, {{first_name}}
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your service with us has ended (account {{account}}). Thank you for being a customer. Before you go, would you tell us why you left and how we could have done better? It takes a minute.

{{survey:farewell}}

If you ever want to come back, we'll be here.
